controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - hook : "Prudential a du prolonger jusqu'en novembre 2026 la suspension des ventes de sa filiale japonaise"
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026, the Company voluntarily extended the new sales suspension for an additional 180 days through November 5, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Le filing qualifie la prolongation de VOLONTAIRE (voluntarily / voluntary extension), pas de contrainte. Remplacer "a du prolonger" par "a prolonge volontairement". La suspension initiale elle-meme est decrite comme "following discussions with the Japanese regulator, the Company voluntarily suspended new sales activity" : pression du regulateur mais decision volontaire.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - "en avril 2026, la suspension a ete prolongee de 180 jours supplementaires, jusqu'au 5 novembre 2026 ; le regulateur japonais (FSA) mene des inspections sur place et Prudential lui rend compte regulierement"
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026, the Company voluntarily extended the new sales suspension for an additional 180 days through November 5, 2026. The Japan Financial Services Agency (“FSA”) is conducting onsite inspections of Prudential of Japan and Prudential Holdings of Japan. The Company is continuing to engage with the FSA and is reporting progress to the FSA on an ongoing basis.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - "suspension volontaire des ventes en fevrier 2026 pendant 90 jours apres une enquete interne ayant revele des manquements d'employes"
controles.verbatim_source: in January 2026, The Prudential Life Insurance Company, Ltd. (“Prudential of Japan”) [...] reported the findings of its internal investigation into incidents of misconduct involving certain employees of Prudential of Japan. [...] in February 2026, following discussions with the Japanese regulator, the Company voluntarily suspended new sales activity at Prudential of Japan for a 90-day period commencing February 9, 2026.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - "le groupe a aussi engage une revue proactive des pratiques commerciales de Gibraltar Life"
controles.verbatim_source: We are proactively reviewing the sales practices of Gibraltar Life Insurance Company, which distributes its products through life consultants and independent agencies.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - ce_qui_affaiblirait : "Conclusion sans sanction significative de l'enquete de la FSA japonaise"
controles.verbatim_source: The Japan Financial Services Agency (“FSA”) is conducting onsite inspections of Prudential of Japan and Prudential Holdings of Japan.
controles.correction_proposee: Le document parle d'inspections sur place (onsite inspections), pas d'une enquete formelle. Ecrire "des inspections de la FSA japonaise". Le corps de l'ATT emploie d'ailleurs le terme correct : l'incoherence est dans ce_qui_affaiblirait.

controles.affirmation: OMISSION MATERIELLE - l'ATT ne chiffre nulle part l'impact de la suspension japonaise
controles.verbatim_source: We estimate that the suspension of new sales as extended will result in a reduction of pre-tax adjusted operating income in the range of $525 to $575 million for 2026 [...] and in the range of $400 to $450 million for 2027 [...] Should the suspension of new sales activities extend beyond November 2026, we estimate that International Businesses' pre-tax adjusted operating income would be reduced by $50 to $60 million per each additional month.
controles.correction_proposee: Rien de faux, mais l'argument le plus fort et le plus verifiable (525-575 M$ d'impact 2026, 50-60 M$ par mois supplementaire) est absent de l'ATT. A ajouter.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "1 566 M$ de pertes nettes realisees sur investissements au T2 2026 et 1 930 M$ sur le S1 2026 (contre 1 699 M$ et 2 429 M$ en 2025)"
CHIFFRE - "Resultat net 985 M$ au T2 2026, +84,8% sur un an ; marge nette de 6,3% sur 15,7 Mds$ de revenus"
controles.verbatim_source: NET INCOME (LOSS) ATTRIBUTABLE TO PRUDENTIAL FINANCIAL, INC. $ 985 $ 533 $ 1,582 $ 1,240 ; Total revenues 15,661 13,726

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "AOCI a -4 060 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre -3 077 M$ fin 2025, degradation portee par les pertes latentes obligataires ; capitaux propres +3,3% sur un an"
controles.verbatim_source: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss)(2) ( 4,060 ) ( 3,077 ) ; rollforward AOCI : Net Unrealized Investment Gains (Losses) ( 18,789 ) -> ( 22,168 ) ; Balance, June 30, 2025 [...] $ 30,582 vs Balance, June 30, 2026 [...] $ 31,577
controles.correction_proposee: Exact (30 582 -> 31 577 = +3,3%). Nuance a mentionner : les capitaux propres RECULENT depuis fin 2025 (32 438 -> 31 577), l'ATT ne retient que la comparaison annuelle favorable.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "Ratio RBC : 415% au 31 decembre 2025", preuve citee : "Its RBC ratio as of December 31, 2025, its most recent statutory fiscal year-end and RBC reporting date, was 415%"
controles.verbatim_source: PICA's RBC ratio as of December 31, 2025, its most recent statutory fiscal year-end and RBC reporting date, was 415%. PICA's RBC ratio is calculated on a consolidated basis and included Pruco Life Insurance Company [...]
controles.correction_proposee: Le verbatim a ete modifie : "PICA's" remplace par "Its". Le ratio est celui de PICA (la filiale d'assurance americaine), pas du groupe Prudential Financial. Restituer la citation exacte et preciser "ratio RBC de PICA".

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "Les revenus du segment Individual Life reculent de 22,1% sur un an au T2 2026, a 1,16 Md$"
controles.verbatim_source: T2 2026 Individual Life : Total revenues 1,161 ; T2 2025 Individual Life (retraite) : Total revenues 1,014. Note 19 : "Effective January 1, 2026, the Company made the following segment reporting changes [...] guaranteed universal life policies, previously included in the Individual Life segment, have been combined into a new reportable segment named U.S. Legacy Products [...] These segment reporting changes are being applied retrospectively".
controles.correction_proposee: Les revenus Individual Life AUGMENTENT de +14,5% (1 014 -> 1 161 M$). Le -22,1% resulte d'une comparaison entre le perimetre 2026 retraite et un perimetre 2025 non retraite (avant sortie des polices GUL vers U.S. Legacy Products). Supprimer cet argument ou le remplacer par une comparaison a perimetre constant.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "le resultat operationnel ajuste du segment US Retirement recule de 13,3% sur un an"
controles.verbatim_source: Adjusted operating income before income taxes by segment [...] Retirement(1) 392 397 964 923 [...] (1) Prior period amounts have been updated to conform to current period presentation.
controles.correction_proposee: Le segment Retirement recule de 1,3% au T2 (392 vs 397 M$) et PROGRESSE de +4,4% sur le semestre (964 vs 923 M$). Le -13,3% provient d'une comparaison avec l'ancien perimetre "Individual Retirement Strategies". Le vrai segment en repli est U.S. Legacy Products : 234 vs 351 M$, soit -33,3%.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "les ventes brutes annualisees (ANBP) du segment International reculent de 33,3%"
controles.verbatim_source: Annualized new business premiums: On an actual exchange rate basis $ 376 $ 541 $ 805 $ 1,117 ; On a constant exchange rate basis $ 361 $ 535 $ 785 $ 1,113
controles.correction_proposee: Le recul reel est de -30,5% au T2 a taux courant (376 vs 541) ou -32,5% a taux constant (361 vs 535), et -27,9% / -29,5% sur le semestre. Aucune de ces valeurs n'est -33,3% (qui correspond en fait au recul de l'AOI U.S. Legacy Products). Retenir -30,5% (taux courant, T2).

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "les depots nets sur ces contrats reculent de 35,2% sur un an au T2 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune ligne "depots nets" a -35,2% dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Les rollforwards de Policyholders' Account Balances donnent Deposits 7,917 (S1 2026) vs 7,707 (S1 2025), soit +2,7%.
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer ou resourcer. Si l'intention est de montrer les sorties du bloc en run-off, citer directement U.S. Legacy Products (AOI 234 vs 351 M$, -33,3%) et le verbatim "net outflows from the run-off of the variable annuity block".

controles.affirmation: NOMMAGE - "Le segment Individual Annuities est en run-off assume", preuve : "net outflows from the run-off of the variable annuity block"
controles.verbatim_source: Verbatim present et exact, mais dans la section U.S. Legacy Products. Note 19 : "The Company's principal operations now consist of PGIM [...] the U.S. Businesses (consisting of Retirement, Group Insurance, Individual Life and U.S. Legacy Products) [...]"
controles.correction_proposee: Le segment "Individual Annuities" n'existe plus dans le reporting T2 2026. Le bloc en run-off s'appelle "U.S. Legacy Products". Renommer, sinon le lecteur ne peut pas retrouver la ligne dans le rapport.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE - "Dette long terme 19,7 Mds$ (+5,3% YoY), tresorerie 15,2 Mds$ (-8,4% YoY), capitaux propres 31,6 Mds$"
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt 19,663 18,856 ; Cash and cash equivalents(1) 15,162 19,712 ; Total Prudential Financial, Inc. equity 31,577 ; Cash and cash equivalents $ 15,162 $ 16,638 (reconciliation cash flow S1 2026 vs S1 2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Montants exacts. Deux reserves mineures : le -8,4% de tresorerie ne se recalcule pas (15 162 vs 16 638 au 30 juin 2025 = -8,9%) ; et le +5,3% de dette n'est pas verifiable dans ce 10-Q, qui ne publie que le comparatif au 31 decembre 2025 (18 856, soit +4,3%).
